document.title: Google Workspace Migration - Habyt to Hmlet
document.subtitle: Phase 1: Active User and Shared Drive Migration

customer.profile: Hmlet operates the destination Google Workspace environment (hmlet.com) and is the contracting party for this migration. Habyt operates the source environment (habyt.com); the two organisations are separating into independent entities, and this engagement transfers an agreed subset of historical Habyt data into the pre-existing Hmlet accounts. Hmlet's technical and IT operations are managed by ZenAdmin, who act as Hmlet's technical point of contact for this engagement. Scope, commercials and timeline run directly between Premier Cloud and Hmlet.

background.objective:
Hmlet is engaging Premier Cloud Inc., a Google Cloud Premier Partner, to migrate an agreed subset of historical Google Workspace data from the Habyt source environment (habyt.com) into Hmlet's existing destination environment (hmlet.com).

This is a Google-to-Google migration of historical data only. Both environments remain independent: no DNS, MX or Autodiscover records are changed, the source domain is not added as an alias or secondary domain under the destination, and destination accounts are already provisioned and in active use. Premier Cloud will transfer mail, Drive, calendar and contacts data for the in-scope accounts, together with the in-scope shared drives, and Habyt will delete the migrated source accounts following the final delta pass.

This SOW covers Phase 1 only. Phase 2 - restoration of archived user data currently held in Spin AI - is a separate engagement and is not scoped, priced or scheduled here.

key_focus_areas.label: Historical Data Migration
key_focus_areas.text: CloudM-driven transfer of mail, Drive, calendar and contacts from habyt.com into pre-existing hmlet.com accounts, using an agreed source-to-destination mapping

key_focus_areas.label: Consolidated Mailbox Handling
key_focus_areas.text: 163 source accounts are consolidated into a single destination account (oldemails@hmlet.com), with each source account preserved as a distinct label so the originating mailbox remains identifiable

key_focus_areas.label: Shared Drive Migration
key_focus_areas.text: Migration of the in-scope shared drives with memberships preserved as they exist in the source environment

key_focus_areas.label: Controlled Source Access
key_focus_areas.text: Access to the Habyt source environment is limited to named Premier Cloud individuals for the duration of the work, performed without subcontracting, and revoked on completion

background.engagement_type: This is an execution engagement. Premier Cloud will perform the migration end-to-end, including environment scan, configuration, pilot, bulk historical migration, delta sync and post-migration validation. No DNS cutover, domain transfer, user provisioning or user renaming is performed, as destination accounts already exist and both domains remain independent.

volumes.label: Total in-scope data
volumes.notes: Active user data across the agreed mapping; distinct from the ~10 TB total in the source environment, which includes accounts not in scope

volumes.label: Shared drives
volumes.notes: Largest: All Properties (447.5 GB), Visual Content - APAC (423 GB), Marketing APAC (292 GB), DAS - Projects and Work (188 GB)

tracks.name: Google Workspace Data Migration (CloudM)
tracks.description: A single execution track. Migration is performed with CloudM Migrate configured to transfer only the accounts named in the agreed mapping, so that no data moves between the two environments outside the approved scope.

phases.name: Phase 1: Preparation & Environment Setup
activities: Environment scan of the Habyt source environment to establish data volumes, account states and migration complexity
Confirmation of the final migration mapping with Hmlet: in-scope user accounts, shared drives and groups
Provisioning of super administrator access on both the source and destination environments for named Premier Cloud individuals
Creation of a Google Cloud project with domain-wide delegation and the required API scopes on both source and destination
Installation and configuration of GAM on both environments to support account administration during the migration
CloudM Migrate configured to migrate only the accounts specified in the agreed mapping, preventing any transfer outside the approved scope
Configuration of the consolidated-mailbox rule: the 163 source accounts mapping to oldemails@hmlet.com are migrated with each source account preserved as a distinct label

phases.name: Phase 2: Pilot Migration
activities: Pilot migration of a small cohort of representative users and the more complex shared drives
Validation of data fidelity, label structure on the consolidated mailbox, and shared drive membership preservation
Measurement of achieved throughput against CloudM API rate limits to inform bulk-wave sequencing
Pilot acceptance reviewed with Hmlet before bulk migration begins

phases.name: Phase 3: Bulk Historical Migration
activities: Bulk transfer of historical mail and Drive data for all in-scope accounts
Migration of the in-scope shared drives with memberships preserved as they exist in the source environment
Ongoing monitoring of CloudM for API rate limiting and throttling, with concurrency tuned in response
Review of error logs and remediation of failures, including ownership issues on suspended or archived source accounts

phases.name: Phase 4: Delta Migration & Completion
activities: Notification to Hmlet ahead of the final delta window
Delta pass to capture mail and Drive changes since the bulk transfer
Final delta pass on the agreed completion date, after which no further data is transferred
Confirmation to Hmlet that migration is complete, enabling Habyt to proceed with deletion of the migrated source accounts

phases.name: Phase 5: Post-Migration Validation & Handover
activities: Review of CloudM reconciliation reports for each migration batch
Spot-check audit of migrated mailboxes, Drive content and shared drive memberships against source counts
Documented list of outstanding remediation items and any known non-migrating content
Deletion by Premier Cloud of any copies of Habyt data held, with written confirmation to Habyt
Project closeout meeting and handover of IT operations for the destination environment to ZenAdmin

Hmlet and Habyt to identify any third-party applications authenticating against Habyt accounts (for example Salesforce, Jira or Zendesk), so that dependencies are resolved before the source accounts are deleted
Habyt to review and approve the final migration scope before source-environment access is granted

scope.statement: This engagement transfers historical Google Workspace data for an agreed subset of accounts from the Habyt source environment into the pre-existing Hmlet destination environment, using CloudM Migrate. Both environments remain independent throughout and after the engagement.
out_of_scope_extra: Phase 2 - restoration and migration of archived user data currently held in Spin AI. Spin AI does not provide migration services and permits restoration only to the originating domain; the technical approach is undetermined and will be scoped, priced and scheduled as a separate engagement

Migration of Slack data. The Habyt Slack subscription permits export of public channels only, excluding direct messages and private channels; Slack is separately operational on the Hmlet side and is not part of this engagement
Migration of Google Chat data. Recorded as out of scope in the agreed migration mapping
Migration of non-Workspace Google products, including Google Analytics and YouTube accounts
Any change to DNS, MX, SPF, DKIM or Autodiscover records on either domain. Mail delivery for the source domain is unchanged by this engagement
Addition of the source domain as an alias or secondary domain under the destination environment. The two domains remain independent entities
Provisioning, renaming or password management of destination user accounts. Destination accounts already exist and are in active use
Deletion of the migrated source accounts. Premier Cloud will confirm migration completion; account deletion is performed by Habyt
Identification, remediation or reconfiguration of third-party applications that authenticate against Habyt source accounts and may be disrupted when those accounts are deleted
Migration of data for any account not named in the agreed source-to-destination mapping reviewed and approved by Habyt

assumptions: Hmlet is the contracting party for this engagement. Scope, commercials and timeline run directly between Premier Cloud and Hmlet
Destination accounts on hmlet.com already exist and are in active use; no user provisioning is performed by Premier Cloud
Super administrator access is provided on both the source and destination environments for the duration of the work

Access to the Habyt source environment is limited to named Premier Cloud individuals, is revoked on completion, and the work is performed by Premier Cloud directly without subcontracting. Elevated or admin-level access will not be extended to Hmlet personnel or any other third party without Habyt's prior written approval
Access and transfer are limited to the approved migration scope, which Habyt will review before work begins
On completion, Premier Cloud will delete any copies of Habyt data it holds and confirm this to Habyt in writing
Premier Cloud will notify Habyt promptly of any unauthorised access to or disclosure of Habyt data

Destination accounts are newly created within a separate Google Workspace tenant, so CloudM throughput is subject to Google API rate limiting on those accounts. Concurrency may be tuned during the pilot and bulk phases, and achieved throughput is not within Premier Cloud's control
The dates in the project plan are target dates. Migration duration depends on throughput achieved against API rate limits, which is measured during the pilot
Habyt provides the source-side information and approvals required for the migration. Premier Cloud and Hmlet are dependent on Habyt for source-environment visibility
success_criteria: All in-scope accounts named in the agreed mapping migrated from habyt.com to hmlet.com, validated against the CloudM reconciliation report
The 163 consolidated source accounts migrated into oldemails@hmlet.com with each source account preserved as a distinct, identifiable label
All in-scope shared drives migrated with memberships preserved as they exist in the source environment
Final delta pass completed and migration completion confirmed to Hmlet, enabling Habyt to proceed with source account deletion
No data transferred outside the migration scope approved by Habyt
Premier Cloud copies of Habyt data deleted and confirmed in writing on completion
Post-migration validation report reviewed and accepted by Hmlet stakeholders

risks.risk: CloudM API throttling against newly created destination accounts constrains migration throughput
risks.mitigation: Measure achieved throughput during the pilot cohort before committing bulk-wave dates; monitor CloudM for rate limiting throughout the bulk phase and tune worker concurrency in response; treat all project plan dates as target dates and communicate throughput risk to Hmlet before it affects a milestone

risks.risk: The in-scope user list is not final. The source environment holds 331 active accounts against an agreed mapping of 221
risks.mitigation: Confirm the final list with Hmlet before the environment scan is signed off; configure CloudM to migrate only named accounts so that scope changes are explicit and controlled

risks.risk: Third-party applications authenticating against Habyt source accounts break when those accounts are deleted
risks.mitigation: Identify dependencies with Hmlet and Habyt during Phase 1; flag affected accounts before the final delta; deletion is performed by Habyt on their own schedule once dependencies are resolved

risks.risk: Premier Cloud and Hmlet have limited visibility of the Habyt source environment, and source-side information depends on a single Habyt contact
risks.mitigation: Route source-side requests through the named Habyt contact with agreed response expectations; escalate through the Premier Cloud account manager where responses would affect a milestone

risks.risk: Three shared drives in the current mapping cannot be located as shared drives in the source environment and may be subfolders of another drive
risks.mitigation: Resolve during the environment scan and confirm the final shared drive list with Hmlet before bulk migration begins

risks.risk: Scope disagreement on Google Groups, recorded as out of scope in the migration mapping but as in scope in the discovery call
risks.mitigation: Confirm with Hmlet before Phase 1 completes; if groups are in scope, address the additional effort through a written change request

deliverables.detail: Environment Scan Report: source-environment data volumes, account states and migration complexity
Confirmed Migration Mapping: agreed source-to-destination user, shared drive and group list, reviewed and approved by Habyt
Pilot Validation Report: data fidelity, consolidated-mailbox label structure, shared drive membership preservation, and achieved throughput
Weekly Migration Status Reports: batch progress, throughput against API rate limits, and blocking issues
Migration Completion Confirmation: written confirmation that the final delta is complete, enabling Habyt to delete the migrated source accounts
Post-Migration Validation Report: CloudM reconciliation summary, spot-check audit results, and outstanding remediation items
Data Deletion Confirmation: written confirmation to Habyt that Premier Cloud has deleted all copies of Habyt data it held
